## About
Nacho Mobile Auto Repair is a neighborhood shop on Westwood Dr in Las Vegas. We do oil changes, heads, engines and transmissions, plus the everyday work that keeps a car safe, like brakes, belts and spark plugs.
Nacho likes to hear and feel the problem for himself. One customer wrote that he took the time to drive with her before putting the car on the lift, and then found a missing caliper bolt that another shop had left behind.
A lot of our work comes from people talking to each other. One reviewer was referred by a friend after trying other auto repair chains, and another has come back to us for more than one repair.
We hold a 4.6 rating from 253 Google reviews. If this is your first time reaching out, we'd be pleased to hear from you. Tell us what you need and what questions you have, and we'll be happy to help.

## Services
- Cambios de aceite: Oil changes, the regular service that keeps your engine running right.
- Cabezas: Cylinder head work when the engine needs more than routine service.
- Motor: Engine work, from diagnosing a problem to getting the engine running strong again.
- Transmicion: Transmission work done here at the shop on Westwood Dr.
- Brake pads and rotors: Brake pad and rotor replacement, plus tracking down grinding and clanking noises.
- Leaking oil: Finding and fixing oil leaks, including on older, high-mileage vehicles.
- Changing belts: Swapping out worn belts, which can also quiet a screeching AC.
- Spark plugs and cooling system checks: Spark plug changes and a look at your cooling system to keep things running cool.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Saturday, 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed on Sunday.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're at 2954 Westwood Dr, Suite A, in Las Vegas.

Q: Can I bring my car in the same day I call?
A: One customer called ahead and was able to drop the car off the same day. Give us a call and we'll let you know what works.

Q: How do I reach Nacho?
A: You can phone the shop or email nachomecanico@yahoo.com. One reviewer texted Nacho in the morning and brought the car in around noon.

Q: Do you work on older vehicles?
A: Yes. One reviewer brought in an old Toyota Previa with an oil leak, and it left with no more leak and new belts.
